title: The Fever Wards
text: A grey fever runs through the tanners' quarter. The sick sweat ink, and the physicians say the stains on their sheets make the same shape, again and again: a door.

temptation.label: Sell the physicians' herbs to the highest bidder.
temptation.text: Your steward knows a buyer upriver who pays in silver for the herbs, and who wants the sheets as well.

triumph.text: The fever breaks within the month. The ink-stained sheets are burned in the square.

holds.text: The quarter is quarantined and the fever starves behind the barricades. So do some of the healthy.

falters.text: The fever reaches the Houses' halls. Doors are drawn on every pillow.

calamity.text: The dead are burned in the squares for a season. The smoke draws doors in the sky.
